name: Carlos Alcaraz

observed.title: Carlos Alcaraz vs Casper Ruud Court-Level Highlights | Paris 2026
observed.camera: court-level, behind the near player (players large and sharp)

observed.title: Carlos Alcaraz vs Ben Shelton Title Battle | Paris 2026 Final Highlights
observed.camera: broadcast (high, wide) plus close-ups between points

outfit.shirt: #1c2340 navy, short sleeves, bright-yellow collar, small yellow square logo on the chest

appearance.hair: dark brown, thick, wavy-curly, medium length
appearance.headwear: none in Paris (no white hairband here, unlike the long-band look in ROSTER)

forehand.stance: open stance, very low base on wide balls; sprints with crossovers to reach it first
forehand.takeback: early unit turn with the left arm across the body; racket taken back high, then dropped low below the ball before the swing
forehand.contact: in front, from a deep knee bend
forehand.finish: wraps across the body over the left shoulder, often with both arms up
forehand.legs: loads the outside (right) leg; the back leg kicks up and around at the finish on hard hits

backhand.stance: neutral to open; steps out with the right leg on returns, open stance on the run
backhand.takeback: high: racket head up behind the left shoulder after the unit turn, then a loop down
backhand.finish: high over the right shoulder, both hands on the grip

running.ready: wide, low stance, weight forward on the balls of the feet
running.splitStep: lands wide and low just as the opponent hits (return at v1 56.6, timed with Ruud's serve contact)
running.firstStep: explosive crossover into a huge first stride; back leg fully stretched behind
running.braking: plants low on the outside leg and hits from the lunge; bends right down to dig out low balls on the run (v1 129.0)
running.recovery: quick side shuffle back to the centre, small steps

mannerisms: clenched fist toward his box or the camera after a winner (v1 65.0, v2 73.0, v2 148.0)

gameHints.player-artist: Paris kit: navy shirt with a bright-yellow collar and small yellow chest logo, neon-yellow shorts, black shoes; dark wavy curls and short beard; no hairband at this event. Exaggerate the low base and the curls.
gameHints.racket-coach: Forehand: high takeback, drop the racket below the ball, wrap finish over the left shoulder. Backhand (two hands): racket head up behind the left shoulder, loop down, finish high over the right shoulder.
gameHints.animator: Very low centre of mass; crossover first step with full back-leg extension; open-stance forehand from a lunge with the back leg flung up; split step that lands as the opponent hits; recover with a side shuffle.
gameHints.body-animator: Split-step landing at the opponent's contact (wide, knees deep); lunge depth: back knee close to the court.

notSeen: serve (in view at v1 75 and v1 126 but not stepped through)
